Package org.osgi.test.cases.event.junit

Class EventAdminTests

java.lang.Object
junit.framework.Assert
junit.framework.TestCase
org.osgi.test.support.OSGiTestCase
org.osgi.test.support.compatibility.DefaultTestBundleControl
org.osgi.test.cases.event.junit.EventAdminTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
junit.framework.Test
public class EventAdminTests extends org.osgi.test.support.compatibility.DefaultTestBundleControl
The EventTestControl is the bundle initially installed and started by the EventTestCase when it is started. It performs the various generic event mechanism tests and reports back to the EventTestCase.

    • testInstallation

      public void testInstallation() throws Exception
      Tests if org.osgi.test.cases.event.tb1 and org.osgi.test.cases.event.tb2 are succesfully installed and if their TBCService serivices are avilable. It is checked if there is exactly one EventAdmin registered service. Verify that the System bundle exists and exports the system services: PermissionAdmin.
